svg.title: Observe, diagnose, retrain deliberately
svg.desc: Service signals, host telemetry and model diagnostics have separate collectors, stores and decision boundaries.
svg.text: Service signals, host telemetry and model diagnostics have separate collectors, stores and decision boundaries.
The recorded retraining probe used drift=false. It proves the integration/admission path, not a naturally occurring alarm or improved predictive accuracy.

API traces and projected agent traces have different scopes. Incomplete/missing-service-name warnings remain visible. Offline PSI uses its fixed training reference; it does not measure accuracy of served model 6.
